doctorate.title: Tramping for Justice: The Dismantling of Jim Crow in Baltimore, 1942–1954

evidence.says: Morgan State identifies David Terry as an associate professor in History and Geography and lists a PhD in History from Howard University; no degree year is supplied.

Emory J. Tolbert’s CV, p. 4, lists David Terry among doctoral dissertations he directed at Howard in 2002, using exactly the linked record’s title, Tramping for Freedom: Desegregation of the Baltimore, Maryland, School District.

The Maryland State Archives library accession list records David Taft Terry’s Tramping for Justice: The Dismantling of Jim Crow in Baltimore, 1942–1954, Howard University, 2002, accession L20070210-1/2.

Civil Rights in Baltimore, Maryland, 1831–1976, p. 83 n. 294 and bibliography p. 165, identifies Tramping for Justice: The Dismantling of Jim Crow in Baltimore, 1942–1954 by David Taft Terry as a Howard University PhD dissertation, 2002.

notes: The linked author, institution, year and title match Tolbert’s dissertation-supervision list. The library and historical documentation give a different dissertation title, used above.
